notes: Read by scripts/check-advisories.mjs. `advisories` holds normalized vendor advisories: any locked version or exact manifest pin inside one of an entry's `vulnerableRanges` fails the check, offline. `vendorFeeds` names the GitHub repositories whose published security advisories the --online layer reads directly, ahead of the aggregated feeds `pnpm audit` uses; every vendor entry is evaluated as published, including entries of advisories recorded here, so a revised vendor range is never hidden by its ledger entry. `vendorEntries` lists, verbatim (package, `vulnerable_version_range`, `patched_versions`), the vendor entries an advisory's normalized ranges replace: use it only for a vendor range the check cannot parse or that over-matches, after review; a vendor entry whose text changes no longer matches and is evaluated again. Add an advisory when a vendor publishes one ahead of OSV; remove it once the patched version is locked everywhere and OSV carries the advisory.
